metadata.description: The project knowledge layer for Claude Code — project maps, elder agents (grandfather/eve/archivist), cross-project registry, spec-driven development, a session hook that injects the always-on rules and nudges on drift, plus opt-in workflow skills

plugins.name: shipkit
plugins.description: 20 skills (8 core + 12 opt-in), 5 agents, 2 knowledge bases (on-demand skills), 9 rules (3 always-on, injected by the session hook; all 9 installed as files by /shipkit:setup, which is what makes the 6 path-scoped ones load). Spec-driven development via /shipkit:spec and /shipkit:decide; one-command episodic memory via /shipkit:connect-memory. /shipkit:unsetup reverts.
